poc_summary: Scope: session-based embeddings + online reranking for product recommendations (traffic slice ~15% of traffic).
Outcomes: Met latency targets (p95 ~120ms), throughput sustained at 350 req/s for 1-node dedicated sim; quality uplift 8-12% NDCG.
Cost: hosted run cost ~18% above Helix target for production traffic. Redwood provided suggestions via Optimize to reduce unit cost (batching + cache), but Helix wanted price certainty.

Decision: POC technically successful, commercial/organizational blockers remain; paused awaiting exec sign-off and procurement approval.
